Tum Rehgaey Jaakar Kahan Abbas Kahan Ho

Khaymon Mein Hai Aah-o-Buka Abbas Kahan Ho

Tooti Hai Kamar Shah Ki Aur Zakhmi Bahot Hain
Uthti Nahi Laash-e-Javan Abbas Kahan Ho

Shabbir Pay Talvaaron Ki Yalghaar Hai Uttho
Har Zakhm Hai Noha Kuna Abbas Kahan Ho

Kartay Hain Sitam Jashn Manaatay Hain Sitamgar
Hain Qaid Mein Shehzaadiyan Abbas Kahan Ho

Hai Raak Pay Bethi Hoowi Aur Khaak Hai Sar Par
Bai Haal Hain Saidaanian Abbas Kahan Ho

Dur Chingaey Lagtay Hain Sakina Kay Tamaachay
Yeh Kamsini Yeh Sakhtiyaan Abbas Kahan Ho

Ayk Shor Bapa Giaara Muharram Ko Tha Gohar
Ho Akbar-o-qasim Kahan Abbas Kahan Ho

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/tum-rehgaey-jaakar-kahan-abbas-kahan-ho-nw-4dee00f6f23c.md\")
_, yaml, body = p.read_text().split(\"---\", 2)
blocks = lambda s: [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split(\"\\n\\n\")]
roman = blocks(\"\\n\".join(line.removeprefix(\"  \") for line in yaml.split(\"romanLyrics: |-\\n\")[1].splitlines()))
urdu = blocks(body)
assert [len(x) for x in roman] == [len(x) for x in urdu] == [2] + [3] * 6
assert [x[0] for x in roman[1:]] == list(\"123456\")
assert [x[0] for x in urdu[1:]] == list(\"۱۲۳۴۵۶\")
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 14 verses in Urdu script and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both versions have a two-line opening followed by six numbered couplets. Updated the Urdu title and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous “Dur Chingaey” as “دُر چھن گئے”.
